text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace couldn't get Mr. C.B.'s 
performance in the Satsuki Sho out of her 
head. Seeing her like this, her Trainer 
spoke up.

Katsuragi Ace now stands at the pinnacle 
race, once said to be in a "different 
world." She just wants to believe in the 
strength that brought her this far.
Trainer's words fired up Katsuragi Ace.

The second leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Japanese Derby. Believing in 
everything she has done up to now— 
Katsuragi Ace puts everything she has into 
it!
